comments:
Looks like efefdd668dece956c4f75039c77fb0c40dfdd3c8 is the culprit.

/cc @ronag

review_comments: Shouldn't this be `assert.strictEqual(socket.writable, false);`? I think this is the regression described in https://github.com/nodejs/node/issues/36029.
No, half open close enforcer runs in next tick.
